nodes.label: GoTalk Extraction Workflow
nodes.rationale: Four GoTalk NOW pages copied from the tablet via wireless ADB, Unity asset-pack sprites, and coordinate screenshot crops because uiautomator cannot see Unity UI.

nodes.label: Unity Artwork Extraction
nodes.rationale: words.db maps words to sprite keys extracted with UnityPy; bundle gaps for custom or photo cards fall back to screenshot crops; Mommy/Daddy use real family photos on black cards.

nodes.label: GoTalk App Wiring
nodes.rationale: Home core mirrors the GoTalk Core words page, folders carry page metadata for the bottom bar, and words without a wav fall back to live TTS; audioId covers label versus spoken-phrase mismatches.
